Q: Applescript: How to paste RTF on clipboard to email on Apple Mail? A:

You can set your variable clipContent with the correct class to start with:

try
    set clipContent to the clipboard as «class RTF »
    -- use «class utf8» if you only want the plain text
on error
    set clipContent to the clipboard
end try

tell application "Mail"
    set newMessage to make new outgoing message with properties {visible:true, subject:"[NOTES] "}
    make new cc recipient at newMessage with properties {address:"EmailAddress"}
    set newMessage's content to clipContent
    activate
end tell

Q: YouTube Data API v3 returns youtube#channel results even when type=video is specified A:

Consider to add the videoType parameter on your request.

Example:

curl \
  'https://youtube.googleapis.com/youtube/v3/search?part=id,snippet&maxResults=50&q=rammstein&regionCode=PL&relevanceLanguage=PL&videoType=videoTypeUnspecified&key=[YOUR_API_KEY]' \
  --header 'Authorization: Bearer [YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN]' \
  --header 'Accept: application/json' \
  --compressed

Here is a working example available on the try-it feature on the YouTube API documentation.

Curious enough, I can't say for sure why, but, it also brings channels, so, you have to exclude those results programmatically.

Here is another example:

curl \
  'https://youtube.googleapis.com/youtube/v3/search?part=id,snippet&maxResults=50&q=rammstein&regionCode=PL&type=video&videoType=videoTypeUnspecified&key=[YOUR_API_KEY]' \
  --header 'Authorization: Bearer [YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN]' \
  --header 'Accept: application/json' \
  --compressed

Q: Zoho: Forms: Google Tag Manager events not firing A:

You’re not doing anything wrong, this is a limitation from Zoho Forms itself.

Zoho uses a GTM allowlist, which restricts which tags can fire inside the form. If your dataLayer shows something like:

allowlist: ["gas", "ua", "v", "c", "e"]

then GA4 tags (gaawc, gaawe) won’t fire, even if your trigger is set up correctly. That’s why GTM preview shows “should fire” but the status is “not fired.”

What you can do:

  • Option 1: Request Zoho support to add GA4 tags to the allowlist

  • Option 2 (recommended): Use PostMessage tracking to send form events to your website and trigger GTM/GA4 from there

In short: this is not a GTM setup issue, it’s Zoho’s allowlist blocking GA4 tags.
